# known-absent.darwin-dev.txt — the REFERENCE-mode expected-absent set for a
# macOS development box.
#
# PROVENANCE
#   host        darwin/arm64 developer laptop (the maintainer's)
#   date        2026-08-27
#   source      measured directly: `REALTOOLS_REFERENCE=1 make realtools-args`
#               plus `go run ./cmd/reconftw health-check` (103 tools: 100 present,
#               3 missing) on this box, phase 18 round 5
#   census      TestRealToolArgVectors      present=37 skipped=2
#               TestRealtoolsVulnsPhase6    present=19 skipped=0
#               TestRealtoolsOSINTPhase7    present=25 skipped=0
#               TestRealtoolsFixedArgVectors present=5 skipped=0
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
#   The compiled-in `smokeKnownAbsent` describes the 2026-08-20 provisioned box
#   and says so, including an explicit instruction NOT to edit it to match a
#   laptop: doing that would silently retarget a reference set at a developer
#   machine and make every future REFERENCE run wrong in the other direction.
#   Seven of its entries (arjun p1radup subwiz subzy urless wafw00f waymore) DO
#   resolve here, so a REFERENCE run against the compiled-in list fails the STALE
#   direction — the ratchet working exactly as designed. This file is the
#   documented way to compare against the right list instead.
#
#   NOTE ON THE GATE'S OWN MESSAGE: release-gates.sh reports the failure as
#   "unverified tools were: dnscewl dnstake", which is the SKIPPED set, not the
#   cause. The cause is the seven stale entries above. The two named tools are
#   correctly declared below and were never what failed.
#
# HOW TO USE
#   REALTOOLS_REFERENCE=1 \
#   REALTOOLS_KNOWN_ABSENT="$PWD/internal/core/backend/testdata/known-absent.darwin-dev.txt" \
#     make realtools-args
#
#   The path must be ABSOLUTE (or relative to internal/core/backend/): `go test` runs
#   with the PACKAGE directory as its working directory, so a repo-relative path is
#   not found — and the reader refuses to fall back, so it fails loudly rather than
#   silently unenforcing the ratchet. That refusal is correct; this note exists so the
#   next person does not have to rediscover it.
#
#   Without REALTOOLS_KNOWN_ABSENT the compiled-in lists are used, unchanged.
#
# FORMAT
#   [<TestFunctionName>]      section per probe
#   <tool> = <reason>         one entry per tool; the reason is REQUIRED
#   # comment                 ignored
#
# BOTH RATCHET DIRECTIONS STILL BITE. A tool that is absent and unlisted fails
# (forward); a tool that is listed and present fails as stale. Seeding the list
# changes WHICH list is compared, never WHETHER it is compared. Three of the four
# sections below are DELIBERATELY EMPTY: on this box every vulns, OSINT and
# fixed-vector tool resolves, so any future absence there is a forward failure
# and must be justified here rather than absorbed.

[TestRealToolArgVectors]
dnscewl = not available on macOS — declared kind="go" (github.com/codingo/dnscewl) but no darwin build is obtainable here, and no clone exists under paths.tools_dir under any casing (18-02 recorded it as correctly absent)
dnstake = present on disk as an UNBUILT Go source tree (~/Tools/dnstake: cmd/, go.mod, no binary) and not on PATH, so it resolves nowhere; `go build ./cmd/dnstake` inside that clone is what would fix it

[TestRealtoolsVulnsPhase6]
# Empty ON PURPOSE: present=19 skipped=0 measured on this box. sqlmap and
# testssl.sh resolve from their clones since 18-02.

[TestRealtoolsOSINTPhase7]
# Empty ON PURPOSE: present=25 skipped=0 measured on this box. The eight
# repo-clone python tools (regulator, EmailHarvester, dorks_hunter, gato,
# SwaggerSpy, Spoofy, cmseek, LeakSearch) resolve through clone-aware Discover.

[TestRealtoolsFixedArgVectors]
# Empty ON PURPOSE: present=5 skipped=0 measured on this box.
